name: Olympic Circuit Technology Co., Ltd
summary: Olympic Circuit Technology Co., Ltd engages in the research, development, production, and sale of various printed circuit boards in China and internationally. It offers multilayer rigid boards, high-precision interconnect HDI, flexible printed circuit boards, and metal-based boards, as well as rigid-flex boards, including HDI. The company serves automotive, consumer, industrial, computer and peripherals, communications, and medical markets. Olympic Circuit Technology Co., Ltd was founded in 1985 and is headquartered in Heshan, China.
